Medium-haul hydrogen freighter concept. Known real-world size mismatch: the supplied research associates near-term hydrogen cargo aircraft with light/regional feeder freighters, smaller than any aircraft NATM's medium/long cargo segmentation represents - this catalog has no short/feeder cargo segment to host a size-appropriate row, so hydrogen_freight_medium is kept as the closest available real option rather than removed outright, with this caveat documented instead of silently resolved. CAPEX multiplier kept at the GENERAL 1.13x conventional acquisition-cost ratio (Hoelzen, 2021, general hydrogen aircraft), applied to the new real-price kerosene_freight_medium anchor - a newer, higher-quality 1.31x figure now exists but is specific to a 165-passenger short-range aircraft, not freight; no freight-specific hydrogen capex study has been found. HC and CO set to exactly 0: hydrogen combustion contains no carbon, so hydrocarbon and carbon-monoxide emissions are physically zero, not an estimate. NOx and smoke number are unchanged - documented gap. lifetime_years set to the evidence-based recommended value: 33 years (A15-A16 hydrogen combustion rule: use host airframe lifetime (medium freighter-class, 33yr)). Was 24 years.
